- You may only move objects you control.

All players use the same coordinate notation: (Rr,Cc) where r is the row number (1–8, top to bottom) and c is the column number (1–8, left to right). For example, (R3,C5) is row 3, column 5. move: <OBJECT> <DIRECTION>

message: done
done: all my objects are placed
